samples.label: sample-01
samples.evidence: Readable objective and 0/8 counter, visible player, coin trail, raised platforms, wooden bridges, trees, and movement/jump/restart prompts.
samples.biggestGap: No visible goal flag or enemy/hazard in the gameplay view.

samples.label: sample-02
samples.evidence: Completion banner, 8/8 counter, goal structure, and replay instruction clearly communicate a finished run.
samples.biggestGap: The screenshot is a sparse end state and provides little evidence of the playable route or platforming challenge.

samples.label: sample-03
samples.evidence: Player, six-coin line, successive raised platforms, wooden bridge, visible flag, objective text, counter, and jump prompts form a very clear playable route.
samples.biggestGap: The scene lacks a visible enemy or hazard and has washed-out, repetitive background presentation.

samples.label: sample-04
samples.evidence: 6/6 counter, goal-reached text, completion overlay, play-again button, and restart prompt confirm successful completion.
samples.biggestGap: The large completion overlay and extreme goal close-up obscure nearly all gameplay context.

comparisonVerdict.rationale: Sample-01 offers the strongest overall visual composition and environmental richness while still showing clear platforming cues. Sample-03 communicates the route and goal more clearly, but its scene is flatter and less visually developed.
